hardRequirement: No telemetry collection, product analytics, crash/error reporting, session-log upload, or phone-home may be active in any shipped profile.
No outbound network request may originate from the harness except model inference, web search/fetch, and MCP servers explicitly configured by the repository owner.
A new upstream change may be merged into the protected branch only when every gate in forkpolicy.gates reports status=pass for that exact commit.
If any gate fails or errors, the sync stays on a side branch: it must not reach the protected branch.
strippedFilePathsNote: Files the strip removed outside the stripped package and documentation trees, derived from `git diff --name-status --diff-filter=D <upstream merge base>..master`. Any surviving reference to one of these paths is strip residue: a stale tsconfig include entry, a composition row, a snapshot expectation or an import. Two further nonexistent entries in tsconfig.host.json (window-controls.e2e.ts, conversation-column-overflow.e2e.ts) are upstream's own stale config, unrelated to telemetry, and are deliberately not part of this list.

ownerDecisions.mergeOnGreen: The owner authorized the daily job to merge into master and push to origin when every required gate passes, and to stop at a side branch when any gate fails.
ownerDecisions.scheduling: In-session daily reminder at 08:00 Europe/Berlin; no launchd job is installed.

gates.description: Deletions, dependencies, composition, artifacts, residual references.
Runtime proof that no non-allowlisted outbound connection is attempted.

requiredGateIdsNote: The hard requirement is a universal over the gate list, which an empty list satisfies vacuously. Every id listed here must exist in `gates`, be `required: true`, and produce a result, or the sync fails before it mutates anything. Removing a gate is therefore not a way to merge without it.
